title: Qalelet Yengele Xongolo.
intro: Qadli le rooci qaraanak qaadik yan acwa yeceeh, miraacinu kee gaadule akkuk, kay gino isih gino luk axawah taniimih taagah. Ken xaagi, nabiyyi, amoytiinu, kee taamah afkan, legacy cabaanam, diini revelation galitte fanah culsaanam.
clues: Anu Yallih taama abeena akkuk doorimeeh, doorime ummattah fanak kaxxa amoytiini yoh yeceen.
Qaleela kee kimbir yollih qagaaqagitak fayyale caddo yaysexeexegeenih.
Birti yi gabat kallaytoh innah xamcinuk yemeete, Yallih fayxil.
Anu gaadule laqnah addat gaadule dacrisa kalali silac bicse.
Anu inki adda gibdi aqayyaarel tatreh namma anaakar cubekal yi qibaadah aracal yiddigille wak.
Anu silaytu kee jinnih amriseh yan miraacah xaqut axcem — too miraaciinu yi xaylok sugte.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
